series_cells.prompt: A clean science illustration of two glass beakers standing side by side on a bench, connected into one single electrical circuit in series. The left beaker holds a clear blue liquid; the right beaker holds a clear colourless liquid. Each beaker has two flat rectangular metal plates dipping vertically into its liquid, hanging from above and not touching each other: the left beaker's plates are reddish copper, the right beaker's plates are pale silver. A single small battery sits above and between the beakers. One wire runs from the battery down into the first plate of the left beaker; a second wire runs from the other plate of the left beaker across to the first plate of the right beaker; a third wire returns from the right beaker's far plate back to the battery — one unbroken loop passing through both beakers, so the same current flows through each. Draw the wires as clean thin dark lines. Simple flat vector-style textbook diagram, bright and uncluttered, seen straight from the front.
